name: clinvar_panel
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
method: The panel BED's intervals, one bcftools region query each, projected onto ten columns. The BED's contig names carry a reference-style prefix and the ClinVar GRCh38 VCF's do not, so a stripped copy of the BED is written to scratch first: querying with the prefixed names returns zero rows, which is indistinguishable from 'no variants here'. The gene column prefers the panel symbol when the record's GENEINFO lists it and falls back to the interval's own symbol, so a record annotated only to a neighbouring gene still names the interval it was pulled from. The intervals carry 20 kb of padding, so some rows legitimately fall in a flanking gene and the gene column must be filtered before any per-gene number is quoted.

inputs.name: ClinVar GRCh38 VCF
inputs.role: the germline classification a clinical laboratory has already submitted
inputs.digest_scope: the digest is of the scratch copy present when this manifest was written. The extract run recorded none, so the tie between that download and the committed extract is file identity on disk, not a digest captured at extract time.

inputs.name: ClinVar GRCh38 VCF index
inputs.role: the tabix index the region queries need

inputs.name: ressources/data-profile/mva_panel_grch38.bed
inputs.role: the gene panel: the intervals queried, and the symbols coverage is reported against

licence: ClinVar is a US-government public resource; NCBI asks for attribution on redistribution and states the data are not intended for direct diagnostic use without review by a genetics professional. Cite PMID 29165669.
patient_data: none. Public reference data only - a gene, a transcript, a published classification or a literature range. This manifest records URLs, releases, digests and counts.
note: 17,832 ClinVar records over the 8 panel intervals, release 2026-08-29. The intervals are padded, so some rows fall in a flanking gene; filter the gene column before quoting a per-gene number.
